Deferred from N5 because JLearn.net classifies 下り|くだり as JLPT N3 and its downbound/train-direction sense is specialized. It should not stay in N5 only to close 下 -> くだり coverage.
Deferred from N5 because JLearn.net classifies 長男|ちょうなん as JLPT N2. It is useful family vocabulary later, but N5 already has stronger beginner family anchors and should not force 男 -> なん coverage.
Deferred from N5 because JLearn.net classifies 父母|ふぼ as later-level and the word is formal beside 父, 母, お父さん, and お母さん. Do not keep it only to cover 父 -> ふ.
Deferred from N5 because JLearn.net classifies 生かす|いかす as JLPT N1 and its make-use-of/keep-alive senses are abstract for beginner coverage.

Deferred from N5 because JLearn.net classifies 上り|のぼり as JLPT N2 and the upbound/train-direction noun is specialized. It should not stay in N5 only to close 上 -> のぼり coverage.
